title: Hymn and Visitor
author: Ansel Thornbury
blurb: Elodie Amberdale, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
